args.message:
Upgrade fastjson 2.8.0 -> 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

CVE-2026-31337 (high): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested
arrays. Fixed in 2.9.4 (and 3.1.0). Bump within the 2.x line.

args.head: upgrade-fastjson-2.9.4
args.title: Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 (CVE-2026-31337)
args.body:
## Summary

Upgrades fastjson from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 in `requirements.txt`.

## Rationale

fastjson 2.8.0 is affected by **CVE-2026-31337** (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays. Per the advisory, affected versions are `<2.9.4` and `>=3.0.0 <3.1.0`; the fix is available in `2.9.4` (and `3.1.0`). We bump within the 2.x line to `2.9.4`.

## Testing

- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `c8b8ab7878` passed ✅

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Checked the advisory**: CVE-2026-31337 (high severity) — unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays in fastjson. Affected: `<2.9.4` and `>=3.0.0 <3.1.0`; fixed in `2.9.4` and `3.1.0`.
2. **Created branch** `upgrade-fastjson-2.9.4` from main and bumped `requirements.txt` from `fastjson==2.8.0` to `fastjson==2.9.4` (smallest fix within the 2.x line, avoiding a major-version jump).
3. **Ran CI** — the run (`ci-0001`) **passed**.
4. **Opened PR #101** against main, requesting review from **alex**: https://git.example/payments-service/pull/101

The PR is now awaiting alex's review; merging into main will require code-owner approval per policy, so I have not merged it.
